body.purpose: Dominant 14px UI type; family is theme-owned via --font-app.

heading.purpose: h1-h6 and card titles via --font-heading; themes may pair a serif (Lora, EB Garamond).

label.purpose: Form labels, table headers, status chips.

shadows.name: shadow-xs
shadows.purpose: Outline buttons and inputs at rest.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Cards. The ceiling for resting surfaces; floating layers (popover/dialog/drawer) may go deeper.

motion.name: easing-rule
motion.purpose: House easing doctrine; all motion collapses under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button; theme accent fill, 90% hover fade, 3px focus ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); border: none; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) - 2px); font-family: var(--font-app, ui-sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action; bordered surface that fills with accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) - 2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: var(--font-app, ui-sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color: var(--accent-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The standard content surface: hairline border, whisper shadow, heading-font title.
components.html:
Today's Sessions
3 submitted, 1 awaiting approval.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 24px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) + 4px); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-heading, var(--font-app, ui-sans-serif)); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-card-body { font-family: var(--font-app, ui-sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Transparent field with hairline border; universal 3px focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; padding: 4px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) - 2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: var(--font-app, ui-sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; transition: color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--secondary, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color: var(--secondary-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-app, ui-sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Quiet nav row using the parallel sidebar token family; accent fill when active.
components.html: SessionsInvoices
components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; width: 200px; background: var(--sidebar, oklch(0.985 0 0)); border-right: 1px solid var(--sidebar-border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: calc(var(--radius, 0.625rem) - 2px); color: var(--sidebar-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-family: var(--font-app, ui-sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: var(--sidebar-accent, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); }

narrative.overview: A calm, well-tuned instrument for running a therapy practice. The system is shadcn/ui discipline applied through one semantic token layer, so the entire look — palette, font pairing, corner radius, even density — swaps per user via eight registered themes while every component stays byte-identical. The identity is carried by tokens, not by any single palette: a hardcoded gray or a one-off hex is a break in the system that all eight themes will expose.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic token vocabulary (shadcn names + --canvas, --skeleton) as the only color channel
Eight complete light+dark palettes; theme also selects font pairing, radius (2px–14px), and density
Flat, bordered surfaces; shadows are whispers; dark mode swaps them for translucent borders
Dominant 14px UI type; headings differentiated per theme
Motion is brief and token-timed (150/200/250ms), fully collapsed under prefers-reduced-motion

rules.name: The Token Law Rule
rules.body: No raw hex, no Tailwind palette classes in dashboard UI. If a needed role is missing, extend the token set in globals.css + all eight themes.css blocks.

rules.name: The Portal Firewall Rule
rules.body: Org primary/secondary colors are client-portal branding only. Dashboard themes never read them; the portal never reads data-theme.

rules.name: The Eight-Theme Proof Rule
rules.body: A visual change is done when it holds in Classic and at least two alternate themes, light and dark.

rules.name: The One-Scale Rule
rules.body: Stay on the Tailwind type scale; hierarchy comes from weight and muted color, not new sizes.

rules.name: The Whisper Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing deeper than shadow-sm at rest; depth beyond that is reserved for genuinely floating layers.

dos: Do route every color through the semantic tokens; extend the token set when a role is genuinely missing.
Do verify changes in Classic + ≥2 alternate themes, both modes, before calling them done.
Do time transitions with --motion-fast/base/slow, entrances ease-out, exits ease-in.
Do keep spacing utility-based so theme density (--spacing) scales it.
Do use --canvas for shell backgrounds and --skeleton for loading fills.
donts: Don't hardcode hex/oklch values, Tailwind gray classes, radii, or font families in dashboard components.
Don't exceed shadow-sm on resting surfaces or add glows.
Don't let dashboard theming touch client-facing surfaces (portal, emailed invoices/PDFs).
Don't add motion outside the prefers-reduced-motion collapse, or one-off easings/durations per component.
Don't move or remove elements that walkthrough tours highlight without re-running the walkthrough audit for every audience.
